scope: Individual reading of19actual separate terminal/desk articles, preserving complete text/links and each assessment; no extra main/FAQ/default-visual credit.

routes.assessment: Read all desk notes: displayed-price market-only fills, no short/resting stops/limits, guest browser versus server account history, fixed0.1%per-side virtual fee and missing real spread/slippage/financing/tax. Position-size, journal and concentration examples are exercises, not evidence of an improved equity curve or live returns. Account restoration/engine behavior is stated content, not independently certified by reading. No order was placed.

Read complete QQQ article: Nasdaq100 non-financial versus technology-only distinction, issuer holdings/weight dates, SPY overlap/concentration worksheet and relative-ratio limits. Rate sensitivity, largest-holding influence and faster-fall narrative require dated evidence rather than being inferred from simulator prices. No universal beginner or profitable risk-on signal is asserted. Full source fit/current holdings and visual/originality stages remain.

Read complete Tesla article: deliveries versus prices/revenue/cost/margin and energy activity; price shock/position-size exercise; conceptual stop versus manual market-only execution and hypothetical gaps. Real volatility/slippage and chief-executive sentiment claims require dated market evidence; issuer reports do not themselves prove a share-price response. No universal allocation or beginner suitability is asserted.

Read complete Amazon article: retail/advertising/AWS activities, matching segment sales versus operating income and margin denominator. Earnings/PrimeDay exercises must use external dated information rather than generated chart reactions. Most-discussed analyst themes, cloud-miss gap and stress narrative remain empirical/source follow-ups, not a universal best-time rule or simulator validation.

Read complete WTI article: benchmark/barrel context, production-refining-consumption chain and different physical constraints; OPEC/EIA research versus hypothetical practice. Simplified instrument is distinguished from deliverable/leveraged/expiring futures. The assertion about most real oil trading using rolled futures needs scope/source follow-up; the EIA general hub alone is not that proof. No oil futures execution or profitable news response is asserted here.

Read complete ETH article: native fees, proof-of-stake, wallet/application/validator risk and missing staking/DeFi/wallet actions in the simulator. Matching ETH/BTC returns do not establish causation or permanent volatility ranking. Block-space demand, staking capital-lock and congestion/fee claims need exact protocol/vehicle and date qualifiers/source mapping. No gas trend or universal indicator predicts future ETH prices.

Read complete BTC article: proof-of-work/current-consensus issuance21million, roughlyfouryear halvings versus price; no company earnings or causal altcoin relationship. Fixed0.1%per-side practice fee is distinguished from real execution/network/custody costs. ETF-flow/dollar/risk-appetite prominence and thinner-weekend-volume claims remain dated empirical source follow-ups. No actual order/chart/real-money readiness certification.

Read complete Apple article: products versus Services, rising sales/falling margin and opposite hypothetical cases, dated event/revenue expectations and no predictable earnings response. Broad size does not establish lower volatility or suitable holding period. Coverage themes/largest-market and event-calendar assertions need dated issuer/source follow-up. No brokerage account or actual announcement replay is claimed for the simulator.

Read complete SOL article: network fees/staking/transactions versus token price; rising-usage/falling-price counterexample and reverse. Operational history and throughput do not prove value or an entry, and no permanent BTC-relative volatility or tight-exit rule is asserted. Outage history, smaller-cap liquidity and most-discussed drivers need dated primary/market evidence; manual exits are distinguished from automatic stops.

Read complete SPY article: fund shares versus index, expenses/tracking/holdings, dated overlapping-weight comparison with QQQ and no institutional-intent inference from volume/options. Scheduled contributions versus lump-sum include a declining scenario. No options engine or universally required beginner fund is asserted. Current holdings/expense/source fit and the claim about technology leading a relative move require evidence rather than a simple return ratio alone.

Read complete META article: FamilyofApps versus RealityLabs, ad revenue/engagement/capital/operating spend and a segment worksheet. Historical drawdown study explicitly requires separately sourced prices; generated history is not actual Meta market history. User-count/earnings reactions and real-versus-practice emotional difficulty remain empirical/source follow-ups. No stock-price prediction follows engagement alone.

Read complete MSFT article: subscriptions/cloud/device business versus revenue/cost, concentration/valuation and changing volatility; a familiar profitable company is not risk-free or universally suitable. Matching holding windows and dated fund holdings are requested. Current segment/company details require dated issuer proof; actual account execution and a steadier-return claim are not certified.

Read complete BNB article: network fee/staking functions, exchange activity/supply/burn/regulatory announcements separated, no company ownership from token holdings or causal future rally. Company/ecosystem concentration, PoSA terminology, access restrictions and weekly independence narrative need precise protocol/jurisdiction/date evidence. No actual exchange access or investment recommendation is certified.

Read complete gold article: explicit PAXG-token-price proxy, token market-cap/volume versus physical-gold market, fallback/generated history and no acquired metal/fund/token. Physical/fund/futures custody, costs and settlement differ. No fixed inverse stock correlation or guaranteed inflation/stress hedge. Opportunity cost, income, long history and key-driver prominence remain primary-source/vehicle/date follow-ups; quote/account model remains separate.

Read complete EURUSD article: USD per EUR; EUR1000at1.10/1.12 is USD1100/1120beforecost, inverse uses division. ECB reference observation differs from executable dealing rate, policy coincidence is not causation, no leverage or actual session-liquidity replay. Pip/account-currency modelINV-FX01 and broad main-driver claims remain unresolved/source follow-ups; reading authorizes no accounting change.

Read complete XRP article: native ledger asset versus Ripple share/rights, token balance versus company entitlement and opposite-shock worksheet. Manual market exits differ from real stops that can slip past a trigger. RPCA nomenclature, legal-reaction ranking, large-holder coverage and scheduled legal events require dated protocol/legal/market sources. Headlines do not determine the next move; no production order was placed.

Read complete NVDA article: DataCenter/Gaming revenue versus costs/prior expectations, hardware/software and share valuation; RSI/news cannot establish an entry. Earnings/reported-price worksheets differ from generated history; a hypothetical10%gap is an input, not a worst-case loss bound. Whole-AI bellwether, export restriction and customer-spend narratives need dated primary/market sources. No universal beginner suitability or next-price response is asserted.

Read complete Alphabet article: GoogleServices/Cloud/OtherBets, separate revenue/operating outcomes and a fictional popular-product-with-cost case; GOOGL/GOOG share classes require actual voting-right documents. No automatic news breakout/volume edge is asserted and generated charts are not actual events. Advertising-share/cloud-growth/most-covered themes remain dated source follow-ups.

Read complete GBPUSD article: USDperGBP; GBP1000at1.20/1.25 is USD1200/1250beforecost, distinct from EUR base currency. Reference/dealing/practice rate purposes differ; DST/holiday/news qualify overlap and no guaranteed liquidity/learning ranking follows. Cable etymology, driver claims and isolating pound versus dollar from a two-pair comparison need source/method follow-up. INV-FX01 remains separate; no leveraged account or order action.
